units.source_text: “到她家去瞧瞧好吗”这种话，即使出自开朗的真砂子之口，也仅是说说而已。

en.t: Even coming from the cheerful Masako, a remark like “Shall we go and have a look at her house?” was only something said in passing.

units.source_text: 然而，千重子却放慢了脚步，几乎要停下来。

en.t: Yet Chieko slowed her steps and almost came to a stop.

units.source_text: 她时而仰望杉山，时而凝视堆放在家家户户门前的杉圆木。

en.t: Now and then she looked up at the cedar-covered hills, and now and then she gazed at the cedar logs piled in front of each house.
